bill.title: AN ACT TO AMEND TITLE 21 OF THE DELAWARE CODE RELATING TO SPECIAL LICENSE PLATES.

posted_text:
🎓 DE SB 305 — Delaware State U Fans: New License Plates Coming

Delaware State University supporters, your car can now show your pride!

This bill creates a special license plate specifically for the university, aiming to boost student access, improve academic programs, and support the university’s overall mission.

Owners of eligible vehicles – primarily private passenger cars and trucks under 26,000 pounds – can apply to the Division of Motor Vehicles for these plates.

A one-time fee of $65, including a $15 administrative fee, will be required to obtain the plate, with the remaining funds dedicated to supporting Delaware State University’s financial aid and academic programs.

The plates will feature the university’s colors and design, and the committee may change the wording to drop the phrase 'The First State' and replace it with the university's name.

Sept. 14, 2026: Signed by Governor.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://legis.delaware.gov/BillDetail?LegislationId=143230
